segments.an3.13:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule [veṇakule (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde appannapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
segments.an3.13:1.6: So ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavhābādho [bahvābādho (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khañjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.
segments.an3.13:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa jeṭṭho putto hoti ābhiseko anabhisitto acalappatto [macalappatto (sī. pī.)].
segments.an3.13:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, rājā hoti khattiyo muddhāvasitto.
segments.an3.13:3.8: Yā hissa, bhikkhave, pubbe anabhisittassa abhisekāsā sā [sāssa (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] paṭippassaddhā.
segments.an3.13:3.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an3.13:4.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
segments.an3.13:4.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
segments.an3.13:4.7: ‘itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’ti.
segments.an3.13:4.9: ‘kudāssu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmī’ti!
segments.an3.13:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo.
segments.an3.13:5.3: So suṇāti āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’ti.
segments.an3.13:5.6: ‘kudāssu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmī’ti!
segments.an3.13:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo.
segments.an3.13:6.4: ‘itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’ti.
segments.an3.13:6.6: ‘kudāssu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā … pe … sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmī’ti!
segments.an3.13:6.8: Yā hissa, bhikkhave, pubbe avimuttassa vimuttāsā sā paṭippassaddhā.
segments.an3.13:6.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsū”ti.

lines: Ettāvatā kulavipattiṃ dassetvā idāni yasmā nīcakule jātopi ekacco aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano, ayaṃ pana na tādiso, tasmāssa bhogavipattiṃ dassetuṃ daliddetiādimāha.
Kasiravuttiketi dukkhajīvike, yattha vāyāmena payogena jīvitavuttiṃ sādhenti, tathārūpeti attho.
Yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhatīti yasmiṃ kule dukkhena yāgubhattaghāso ca kopīnamattaṃ acchādanañca labbhati.
Idāni yasmā ekacco nīcakule jātopi upadhisampanno hoti attabhāvasamiddhiyaṃ ṭhito, ayañca na tādiso, tasmāssa sarīravipattimpi dassetuṃ so ca hoti dubbaṇṇotiādimāha.
Jeṭṭhoti aññasmiṃ jeṭṭhe sati kaniṭṭho āsaṃ na karoti, tasmā jeṭṭhoti āha.
Ābhisekoti jeṭṭhopi na abhisekāraho āsaṃ na karoti, tasmā ābhisekoti āha.
Anabhisittoti abhisekārahopi kāṇakuṇiādidosarahito sakiṃ abhisitto puna abhiseke āsaṃ na karoti, tasmā anabhisittoti āha.
Acalappattoti jeṭṭhopi ābhiseko anabhisitto mando uttānaseyyako, sopi abhiseke āsaṃ na karoti.
Soḷasavassuddesiko pana paññāyamānamassubhedo acalappatto nāma hoti, mahantampi rajjaṃ vicāretuṃ samattho, tasmā “acalappatto”ti āha.

Saṅkassarasamācāroti saṅkāhi saritabbasamācāro, kiñcideva asāruppaṃ disvā “idaṃ iminā kataṃ bhavissatī”ti evaṃ paresaṃ āsaṅkanīyasamācāro, attanāyeva vā saṅkāhi saritabbasamācāro, sāsaṅkasamācāroti attho.
Tassa hi divāṭṭhānādīsu sannipatitvā kiñcideva mantayante bhikkhū disvā “ime ekato hutvā mantenti, kacci nu kho mayā katakammaṃ jānitvā mantentī”ti evaṃ sāsaṅkasamācāro hoti.
Assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiññoti assamaṇo hutvāva samaṇapatirūpakatāya “samaṇo ahan”ti evaṃ paṭiñño.

Abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiññoti aññe brahmacārino sunivatthe supārute sumbhakapattadhare gāmanigamarājadhānīsu piṇḍāya caritvā jīvikaṃ kappente disvā sayampi tādisena ākārena tathā paṭipajjanato “ahaṃ brahmacārī”ti paṭiññaṃ dento viya hoti.
“Ahaṃ bhikkhū”ti vatvā uposathaggādīni pavisanto pana brahmacāripaṭiñño hotiyeva, tathā saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ gaṇhanto.
Tatiye santoti ettha santa -saddo “dīghaṃ santassa yojanan”tiādīsu (dha. pa.60) kilantabhāve āgato.
“Ayañca vitakko, ayañca vicāro santo honti samitā”tiādīsu (vibha.576) niruddhabhāve.
“Adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo, gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto”tiādīsu (dī. ni.2.67; ma. ni.1.281; saṃ. ni.1.172; mahāva.7-8) santañāṇagocaratāyaṃ.
Atthibhāvo hettha puggalasambandhena vuttattā lokasamaññāvaseneva veditabbo, na paramatthavasena.
Atthīti cetaṃ nipātapadaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ “atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā”tiādīsu (ma. ni.1.110) viya.
Puiti karīsassa nāmaṃ, taṃ kusenti apanentīti pukkusā, pupphacchaḍḍakā.
Laku viya ghaṭikā viya ḍeti pavattatīti hi lakuṇḍako, rasso.
Taṃ panassa nimīlanaṃ ekena akkhinā dvīhipi cāti āha “ekakkhikāṇo vā ubhayakkhikāṇo vā”ti.
Heṭṭhimakāyasaṅkhāto sarīrassa pakkho padeso hato assāti pakkhahato.
Āsaṃ na karotīti rajjābhiseke kaniṭṭho patthanaṃ na karoti jeṭṭhe sati kaniṭṭhassa anadhikārattā.
Sīlassa duṭṭhu nāma natthi, tasmā abhāvattho idha du-saddoti āha “nissīlo”ti.
“Pāpaṃ pāpena sukaran”tiādīsu (udā.48; cūḷava.343) viya pāpa-saddo nihīnapariyāyoti āha “lāmakadhammo”ti.
Saṅkāhi saritabbasamācāroti “imassa maññe idaṃ kamman”ti evaṃ parehi saṅkāya saritabbasamācāro.
Attanāyeva vā saṅkāhi saritabbasamācāroti etenapi kammasādhanataṃyeva saṅkassarasaddassa dasseti.
Attano saṅkāya paresaṃ samācārakiriyaṃ sarati āsaṅkati vidhāvatītipi saṅkassarasamācāroti evamettha kattusādhanatāpi daṭṭhabbā.
Tassa hi dve tayo jane kathente disvā “mama dosaṃ maññe kathentī”ti tesaṃ samācāraṃ saṅkāya sarati dhāvati.
Evaṃpaṭiññoti salākaggahaṇādīsu “kittakā vihāre samaṇā”ti gaṇanāya āraddhāya “ahampi samaṇo, ahampi samaṇo”ti paṭiññaṃ datvā salākaggahaṇādīni karotīti samaṇo ahanti evaṃsamaṇappaṭiñño.
Atha vā kasambu vuccati tintakuṇapakasaṭaṃ udakaṃ, imasmiñca sāsane dussīlo nāma jigucchanīyattā tintakuṇapaudakasadiso, tasmā kasambu viya jātoti kasambujāto.
Lokuttaradhammaupanissayassa natthitāyāti yattha patiṭṭhitena sakkā bhaveyya arahattaṃ laddhuṃ, tassā patiṭṭhāya bhinnattā vuttaṃ.
Mahāsīlasmiṃ paripūrakāritāyāti yattha patiṭṭhitena sakkā bhaveyya arahattaṃ pāpuṇituṃ, tasmiṃ paripūrakāritāya.
